```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(targets)
library(Seurat)
library(decoupleR)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(DT)


COND_PAL   <- c(WT = "#1f78b4", "mCh-" = "#a6cee3", "mCh+" = "#e31a1c")
COND_ORDER <- c("WT", "mCh-", "mCh+")

TARGET_GENES <- c("Mmp14", "Mmp16", "Rarb", "Dmxl2")
```

```{r load}
tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)   # DietSeurat: SCT data layer + UMAP + metadata

DefaultAssay(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "SCT"

clust_col <- grep("sNN_pca.*_res\\.0\\.1$",
                  colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]

# UMAP coords + condition derived directly from the Seurat object
base_umap_df <- as.data.frame(
    Embeddings(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, reduction = "umap.nn")
  ) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |>
  dplyr::rename(UMAP1 = umapnn_1, UMAP2 = umapnn_2) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sample.name = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$sample.name[cell_id],
    condition   = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("mCh\\+", sample.name) ~ "mCh+",
      grepl("mCh-",   sample.name) ~ "mCh-",
      grepl("WT",     sample.name) ~ "WT",
      TRUE ~ sample.name
    )
  )
```

---

# 1 · Run upstream analysis

```{r fetch-networks}
# OmnipathR 3.18.x has a parsing bug with its evidences system; both servers
# are reachable, so we fetch directly via the REST API and cache to disk.
cache_dir   <- file.path("output/objects/cache")
tf_net_path <- file.path(cache_dir, "dorothea_mouse_ab.csv")
pw_net_path <- file.path(cache_dir, "progeny_mouse_top500.csv")
dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (!file.exists(tf_net_path)) {
  message("Downloading DoRothEA mouse A/B from OmniPath REST API...")
  url <- paste0(
    "https://omnipathdb.org/interactions?",
    "genesymbols=1&datasets=dorothea&dorothea_levels=A,B",
    "&organisms=10090&fields=dorothea_level,is_stimulation,is_inhibition"
  )
  raw <- readr::read_tsv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)
  tf_net_raw <- raw |>
    dplyr::filter(is_stimulation != is_inhibition) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      source     = source_genesymbol,
      target     = target_genesymbol,
      mor        = ifelse(is_stimulation == 1L, 1L, -1L),
      confidence = dorothea_level
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(source, target, .keep_all = TRUE)
  readr::write_csv(tf_net_raw, tf_net_path)
  message(sprintf("  Cached %d TF-target pairs -> %s", nrow(tf_net_raw), tf_net_path))
}

if (!file.exists(pw_net_path)) {
  message("Downloading PROGENy weights from OmniPath REST API...")
  # Annotations endpoint returns key-value rows: label="pathway"|"weight" per record_id.
  # Human gene symbols are title-cased to match mouse convention (MMP14 → Mmp14).
  url <- "https://omnipathdb.org/annotations?resources=PROGENy"
  raw <- readr::read_tsv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)
  pw_net_raw <- raw |>
    dplyr::select(genesymbol, label, value, record_id) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols     = c(genesymbol, record_id),
      names_from  = label,
      values_from = value
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      target = stringr::str_to_title(genesymbol),
      source = pathway,
      weight = as.numeric(weight)
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(weight)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(source, target) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(abs(weight), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::group_by(source) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(abs(weight), n = 500, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  readr::write_csv(pw_net_raw, pw_net_path)
  message(sprintf("  Cached %d pathway-gene pairs -> %s", nrow(pw_net_raw), pw_net_path))
}

tf_net <- readr::read_csv(tf_net_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
pw_net <- readr::read_csv(pw_net_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("DoRothEA: %d pairs (%d TFs) | PROGENy: %d pairs (%d pathways)\n",
            nrow(tf_net), dplyr::n_distinct(tf_net$source),
            nrow(pw_net), dplyr::n_distinct(pw_net$source)))
```

```{r run-analysis}
run_upstream_analysis <- function(
    seu,
    tf_network   = tf_net,
    pw_network   = pw_net,
    target_genes = TARGET_GENES,
    group_var    = "sample.name"
) {
  mat <- as.matrix(GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT", layer = "data"))
  mat <- mat[, !duplicated(colnames(mat))]

  # TF activities (DoRothEA)
  tf_acts <- run_wmean(
    mat, tf_network,
    .source  = "source",
    .target  = "target",
    .mor     = "mor",
    times    = 100,
    minsize  = 5
  )

  # Pathway activities (PROGENy)
  pw_acts <- run_wmean(
    mat, pw_network,
    .source  = "source",
    .target  = "target",
    .mor     = "weight",
    times    = 100,
    minsize  = 5
  )

  # Reshape to features × cells matrices (select only needed cols to avoid
  # p_value / statistic acting as extra pivot id-columns → duplicate source rows)
  tf_mat <- tf_acts |>
    filter(statistic == "norm_wmean") |>
    select(source, condition, score) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = score,
                values_fn = mean) |>
    column_to_rownames("source") |>
    as.matrix()

  pw_mat <- pw_acts |>
    filter(statistic == "norm_wmean") |>
    select(source, condition, score) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = score,
                values_fn = mean) |>
    column_to_rownames("source") |>
    as.matrix()

  # Add as assays (align to Seurat cell order)
  shared_cells <- intersect(colnames(tf_mat), colnames(seu))
  seu <- seu[, shared_cells]
  seu[["TF_activity"]]      <- CreateAssayObject(data = tf_mat[, shared_cells])
  seu[["Pathway_activity"]] <- CreateAssayObject(data = pw_mat[, shared_cells])

  # Score cells for target-gene expression
  genes_present <- intersect(target_genes, rownames(mat))
  cat("Target genes found in SCT assay:", paste(genes_present, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  seu$target_gene_score <- colMeans(mat[genes_present, shared_cells, drop = FALSE])

  # Differential TF activity: target-gene-high vs low
  Idents(seu) <- ifelse(
    seu$target_gene_score > median(seu$target_gene_score),
    "target_high", "target_low"
  )

  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "TF_activity"
  tf_diff <- FindMarkers(
    seu,
    ident.1          = "target_high",
    ident.2          = "target_low",
    test.use         = "wilcox",
    logfc.threshold  = 0,
    min.pct          = 0
  )

  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "Pathway_activity"
  pw_diff <- FindMarkers(
    seu,
    ident.1          = "target_high",
    ident.2          = "target_low",
    test.use         = "wilcox",
    logfc.threshold  = 0,
    min.pct          = 0
  )

  list(
    seurat               = seu,
    tf_differential      = tf_diff,
    pathway_differential = pw_diff,
    tf_acts              = tf_acts,
    pw_acts              = pw_acts
  )
}

results <- run_upstream_analysis(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- results$seurat
tf_diff  <- results$tf_differential
pw_diff  <- results$pathway_differential
```

# 2 · Target gene score

Distribution of the composite target-gene score (`r paste(TARGET_GENES, collapse = ", ")`) across
cells, split by condition.

```{r target-score-umap, fig.width=11, fig.height=4}
umap_df <- base_umap_df |>
  dplyr::filter(cell_id %in% colnames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(score = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$target_gene_score[cell_id]) |>
  dplyr::arrange(score)

p_score <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = score)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = c("#f0f0f0", "#feb24c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
    name    = "Target\nscore"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Target gene score") +
  theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))

p_vln <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(condition, score, fill = condition)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, colour = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey30") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = COND_PAL) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = COND_ORDER) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Target gene score") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_score + p_vln + patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))
```

---

# 3 · Differential TF activity

TFs with significantly different activity between target-gene-high and -low cells.

```{r tf-diff-table}
datatable(
  tf_diff |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("TF") |>
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))),
  rownames  = FALSE,
  filter    = "top",
  caption   = sprintf("Differential TF activity: target_high vs target_low (%d TFs)", nrow(tf_diff)),
  options   = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r tf-diff-volcano, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
tf_vol <- tf_diff |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("TF") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig   = p_val_adj < 0.05 & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25,
    label = ifelse(sig, TF, NA_character_)
  )

ggplot(tf_vol, aes(avg_log2FC, -log10(p_val_adj + 1e-300),
                    colour = sig, label = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.8, max.overlaps = 20,
                            min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "#e31a1c"),
                      guide = "none") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  labs(
    x     = "avg log2FC (target_high vs target_low)",
    y     = "-log10(adj p-value)",
    title = "Differential TF activity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```

```{r tf-umap, fig.width=14, fig.height=4}
top_tfs <- tf_diff |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("TF") |>
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(abs(avg_log2FC), n = 6) |>
  dplyr::pull(TF)

if (length(top_tfs) > 0) {
  DefaultAssay(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "TF_activity"
  tf_umap_df <- umap_df |>
    dplyr::bind_cols(
      as.data.frame(t(GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, assay = "TF_activity",
                                   layer = "data")[top_tfs, umap_df$cell_id,
                                                   drop = FALSE]))
    )

  plots <- lapply(top_tfs, function(tf) {
    tf_umap_df |> dplyr::arrange(.data[[tf]]) |>
      ggplot(aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, colour = .data[[tf]])) +
      geom_point(size = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_colour_gradientn(
        colours = c("#f0f0f0", "#feb24c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
        name    = "activity"
      ) +
      labs(title = tf) +
      theme_void(base_size = 9) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
  })
  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1)
} else {
  message("No significant TFs at padj < 0.05")
}
```

# 4 · Differential pathway activity

```{r pw-diff-table}
datatable(
  pw_diff |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("pathway") |>
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4))),
  rownames  = FALSE,
  filter    = "top",
  caption   = sprintf("Differential pathway activity: target_high vs target_low (%d pathways)", nrow(pw_diff)),
  options   = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r pw-diff-barplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
pw_diff |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("pathway") |>
  dplyr::arrange(avg_log2FC) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pathway   = factor(pathway, levels = pathway),
    direction = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, "up", "down"),
    sig       = p_val_adj < 0.05
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(avg_log2FC, pathway, fill = direction, alpha = sig)) +
  geom_col(colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c(up = "#b2182b", down = "#2166ac"), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 0.4),
                     labels = c("TRUE" = "padj < 0.05", "FALSE" = "n.s."),
                     name   = NULL) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  labs(x = "avg log2FC (target_high vs target_low)", y = NULL,
       title = "PROGENy pathway activity") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11)
```
